== Source face comparison ==
[[:File:ANH-D-enhancedtielasercannon-decipher-archive.gif|The Decipher archive face]] and the exact 2018 PC E face both show destiny 5. [[:File:ANH-D-enhancedtielasercannon-errata-hires.webp|The credited HiRez recreation]] leaves that destiny circle absent, although its no-total game wording matches the older Errata text. The 2023 D-E1 PC face instead adds “total” before destiny. The HiRez file is retained as its own source asset, not treated as an exact scan or assigned a new PC identity. The Errata article uses the clearly credited 2018 PC rendering for matching older words and visible destiny 5. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
